theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type} [Field k] [Group G] (r : G →* (AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (M : Rep.{0} k G) [FiniteDimensional k M], (∀ m : M, ∃ F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F ∧ ∀ g : G, r g ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → M.ρ g m = m) → ∃ F : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), FiniteDimensional ℚ F ∧ ∀ g : G, r g ∈ F.fixingSubgroup → ∀ m : M, M.ρ g m = m
